verdict.rationale: Lever documents its own Data API covering core recruiting objects: listing and creating applications, listing deleted applications, audit events, plus OAuth, webhooks and a sandbox environment. Nothing shows UI-API parity, and many UI-centric features (career site builder, analytics dashboards, Automation Hub, AI form builder and interview tools) have no documented API equivalents. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, API coverage for dashboards/reporting, career site configuration, Automation Hub rules and AI features, and independent corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
